title: Get Engagement Task Performances
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /customer_engagement/202412/performances

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Retrieve detailed performance metrics for a customer engagement task, including message reads, order conversions, and other key engagement statistics.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
shop_cipher string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Shop_cipher is required for cross-border shops, and optional for local shops. It's unique for each shop. Get the this property from the Get Authorized Shop API dynamically. Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
task_ids []string Y [8646958016719848812] The customer engagement task IDs for which to retrieve performance data. Provide 1 to 50 IDs; each ID must be a base-10 string that fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/customer_engagement/202412/performances?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Body

{"task_ids":[8646958016719848000]}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^task_performances []object The requested list of task performance.
^^id string 8646958016719848812 The customer engagement task ID for this performance record.
^^status string SENDING The status of the task.
Possible values:
  • UNKNOWN: The task status is unknown.
  • DRAFT: The task is in draft status.
  • WAITING: The task is waiting.
  • SENDING: The task is sending messages.
  • FAILED: The task failed to send messages.
  • CANCELED: The task was canceled.
  • SUCCESS: The task completed successfully.
  • DELETED: The task was deleted. | ^^sent_recipient_count |int |100 |The number of users that received the message. | ^^read_recipient_count |int |20 |The number of users that read the message. | ^^order_count |int |10 |The number of orders resulting from the message. | ^^gmv_amount |string |5.50 |The revenue from the converted orders. | ^^claimed_coupons_count |int |1 |The number of coupons claimed. |

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"task_performances":[{"id":"8646958016719848812","status":"SENDING","sent_recipient_count":100,"read_recipient_count":20,"order_count":10,"gmv_amount":"5.50","claimed_coupons_count":1}]},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
